verdict.rationale: Deliverability monitoring is a fair question for an email platform like Loops, but the evidence pack never documents per-send bounce, complaint, or blocklist signals, or guidance when deliverability degrades. Guardian message checks, domain setup docs, and an email best-practices skill are adjacent features, not the deliverability reporting this story asks for.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
